moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The thrilling 100-ball cricket tournament culminates in Finals Day at Lord's, with both men's and women's champions crowned.

angles.name: Finals Hype
angles.copy: Who's taking home the silverware? The Hundred Finals Day is set for Lord's this Sunday! Get ready for explosive cricket.

angles.name: Women's & Men's Finals
angles.copy: Double header of champions! Both the men's and women's finals of The Hundred will be decided on Sunday. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Community Shield: Man City vs Arsenal
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the Community Shield, sees Manchester City face Arsenal at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Season Opener Hype
angles.copy: Football's back! The Community Shield kicks off next Sunday with Man City vs Arsenal. Who's winning the first trophy of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff hosts the Community Shield this year! A huge game for Welsh football fans as City take on Arsenal.

moments.title: Roots Picnic UK wraps up
moments.blurb: The inaugural Roots Picnic UK festival, bringing a blend of hip hop, music, culture and community, concludes today at Crystal Palace Bowl in London.

angles.name: Festival Finish
angles.copy: That's a wrap for the first ever Roots Picnic UK! Who caught the vibes at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend?

angles.name: London's New Festival
angles.copy: London just got a brand new festival! Roots Picnic UK brought the hip hop and culture to Crystal Palace Bowl. What were your highlights?

moments.title: Boomtown Festival kicks off

angles.name: Boomtown Begins
angles.copy: Get ready for Chapter Three! Boomtown Festival opens its gates in Hampshire this Wednesday for a week of incredible music and immersive storytelling.

angles.name: Festival Prep
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Boomtown! Who's heading to Hampshire this week for one of the UK's most unique festival experiences?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for a record-extending 20th non-consecutive week.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean make it 20 weeks at UK Number 1 with 'Rein Me In'. An incredible achievement!

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: 20 weeks at the top! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are making history with 'Rein Me In' on the Official Singles Chart. Is it your favourite #1?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'petal' new chart entry

angles.name: New Ariana
angles.copy: New music from Ariana Grande! 'petal' is a fresh entry at Number 4 on the Official UK Singles Chart. Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Chart Debut
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's 'petal' blossoms into the UK Top 5! A big new entry at #4 this week. What do you think of her latest?

moments.title: Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' at #2

angles.name: World Cup Anthem
angles.copy: Still dominating the charts! Shakira & Burna Boy's World Cup anthem 'Dai Dai' is holding strong at Number 2. That post-final buzz is real!

angles.name: Shakira & Burna Boy
angles.copy: It's the track everyone's still talking about! 'Dai Dai' by Shakira & Burna Boy is this week's Number 2 on the UK chart. Still got it on repeat?
